Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Parson 6-Drawer Wood Bedroom Dresser, 60"W, Natural
Colors: Brown
Materials: stone
This is modern farmhouse at its best. Oak veneer gives a distinctive grain to the body and drawers of this dresser, and metal pulls complete the simple design. The natural beauty of this piece provides a relaxing tone to your bedroom. 60"W x 19"D x 35"H Solid hardwood with hand-selected oak veneer This rustic dresser has the look of natural reclaimed wood with distressed finish. Self-closing drawers are suspended on concealed ball-bearing extension glides. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
